name: Who is the new maid?
source:
There is a rumor that the new maid is a lesbian. And a slut. You're Stephanie, the oldest of three sisters, and it is your responsibility to make sure the new maid fits in at the manor. 

[From [url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/who-is-the-new-maid]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有传闻说，新来的女仆是女同性恋，而且是个荡妇。你是Stephanie，三姐妹中的大姐，负责确保新女仆能融入庄园。

[来源：[url=https://leafletgames.itch.io/who-is-the-new-maid]Itch.io[/url]]
